source.note: Kenney train-electric-city-a (the front/cab car of the city electric train; the kit also has train-electric-city-b and -c, the middle and rear cars, not shipped here). FBX member plus its colormap texture, flattened to 20 colours, as train-bullet. Scaled with the same factor as train-bullet (kit units x 2.26), which puts the roof 3.8 m above the rail, a real commuter car height. Stylized proportions: 5.42 m long and 2.48 m wide (a real commuter car is ~20 m by 2.8-2.95 m). Silver-white body with a red line and a navy underframe, so it pairs with the white-and-navy bullet train. Static, no clips.
